title: Enterprise LLM Hallucination Detection & Citation Grounding: HHEM / LettuceDetect Span NLI vs. Token Logprob vs. LLM-as-a-Judge

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Synchronous 70B LLM-as-a-Judge Claim Decomposition (Inline RAGAS Faithfulness)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Offline batch evaluation & 1% asynchronous production sampling only

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Raw Token Logprob / Perplexity Heuristic (Single-Sample Confidence)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Insufficient standalone (LLMs exhibit high confidence on fabricated facts)

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Token-Level NLI Span Detector (LettuceDetect / ModernBERT-Large / HHEM-2.1)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Fast full-response NLI grounding check on 150M-400M encoder

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Streaming Sentence NLI (LettuceDetect) + Deterministic Number/Entity Guard + 6% Gray-Zone Judge
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production financial/legal/medical RAG requiring <20ms tail overhead & >96% recall
